reason: The label is honestly the cleanest I've seen on a caffeinated can: water, mate, fruit concentrate, done. I'd grab one or two in a café to swap for the energy drink I keep next to me during exam prep, but I'm not committing to a habit yet.
objection: 55 CZK is a lot for what is basically cold-brewed tea with lemon, when I can make matcha or mate at home for a fraction of that and get the same caffeine.
would_change_my_mind: A multipack price on the e-shop closer to 40 CZK a can, plus a bio certification, would make it a regular study-night purchase instead of an occasional treat.
